resources.string: Total tiles = megakaryocyte icons × platelet tiles per icon. At a fixed tiles-per-icon setting, each extra icon adds that many tiles. The chart uses the nearest whole icon count.

Real platelets are small fragments of cytoplasm from bone marrow megakaryocytes, not whole cells. For this counting exercise, imagine that each megakaryocyte icon has a set of pre-labeled tiles. Each tile stands for one hypothetical platelet. These invented counts do not represent real platelet yield, blood test thresholds, or clot growth, and they are not laboratory instructions.
